author: Noema I
title: Pooling Contrast: DSConv Concat Mean+MHA (No-PE) — Seed=42
abstract: Controlled replication of DSConv (no RNN) with concat(mean + fixed-query MHA, τ=0.5) to contrast against DSConv mean+max under the same unified setup. Seed=42.
